I have shared these money rules for years—but do they actually work on a ₹30,000 salary? I test 10 of them using Rohan, a fictional 25-year-old earning ₹28,000 in hand, with ₹16,400 in monthly essentials. From the 50/30/20 budget to emergency funds, rent, insurance and EMIs, I look at which rules hold up, which need changing and which fall apart.
